# QAMW Consulting

> Seattle-based, Black-owned and women-owned systems consulting firm for
> owner-operated small and mid-sized businesses ($1M+ revenue) and nonprofits.
> We find where operations are losing time and money (disconnected tools,
> manual work, untrustworthy reporting) and deliver a prioritized plan to fix it.
> Founded and led by Quinita Whitfield, with 14+ years of enterprise data,
> reporting, and systems experience (Power BI, SAP, Tableau, CRM architecture
> and automation).

## Flagship offer: Revenue Leak & Systems Audit
- Flat fee: $5,000
- Timeline: 2 weeks
- Fee is credited 100% toward implementation or a Fractional COO retainer
- Five deliverables:
  1. Systems Map: full inventory of the tech stack, data touchpoints, and integration gaps
  2. Data & Reporting Reality Check: which reports and dashboards can't be trusted, and why
  3. Revenue Leak Analysis: inefficiencies tied to estimated dollar values, ranked by impact
  4. AI Readiness Score: rated across 5 readiness dimensions
  5. 30-60 Day Execution Plan: prioritized fixes and automation opportunities
- Includes a final readout call and 2 weeks of async follow-up
- Client time required: a couple of hours from key people in week one

## Ongoing work
- Fractional COO / embedded systems role: $12,000 per month
- Project-based implementation after the audit

## Other services
- Nonprofit consulting
- Nonprofit technical support
- Systems integration consulting
- Nonprofit Claude (AI) training: workshop and cohort program

## Who we work with
- Growing businesses with $1M+ revenue, and nonprofits
- No dedicated internal data or systems team
- Operations spread across 3-4+ tools that don't talk to each other
- Teams spending hours on manual reporting and admin
- Leaders who want to get more from tools they already own before buying new ones

## Not a fit
- Pre-revenue businesses, or anyone looking for a cheap quick fix
- Requests to "just set up a tool" without looking at the workflow

## Location
Seattle, Washington. Works with clients remotely.

## How to get started
- Free 20-minute discovery call: https://tidycal.com/quinitaw/discovery-call
- Free Skill Gap Finder (90-second quiz that matches small businesses and nonprofits to the Claude skills that fit their tech stack): https://www.qamwconsulting.com/skill-gap-finder.html
